record.default: research only; no clinical publication or automation without qualified review
record.scope: Additive index, not replacement for original safety records; most restrictive applicable rule wins.

existing_release_holds.rule: RP001 contains an unsafe pregnancy recommendation. RP005 has text/table discrepancies. Neither may drive automated advice or chart publication; retain evidence context.
RP001 contains an unsafe pregnancy recommendation. RP005 has text/table discrepancies. Neither may drive automated advice or chart publication; retain evidence context.

dependent_outcome_holds.rule: Block affected estimates dependent on retracted trials pending outcome-specific reanalysis; not a formal retraction claim.
Block affected estimates dependent on retracted trials pending outcome-specific reanalysis; not a formal retraction claim.
Block pregnancy and live birth pooled effects and downstream use; includes DR023. Do not automatically invalidate unrelated semen outcomes.

claim_constraints.finding: Common MTHFR variants do not establish need to replace folic acid with 5-MTHF; CDC recommends folic acid, which has direct NTD prevention evidence. DHFR substitution claim unverified. CDC clinician guidance starts at least one month before conception; three months can be planning preference not universal minimum.

Acute fetal hemodynamic outcomes and self-selected lifting survey cannot establish universal heavy-lifting, Valsalva or supine exercise safety. No home fetal heart-rate thresholds or blanket clearance.
Acitretin pregnancy avoidance period is at least 3 years; nursing warning separate. Do not promise safe conception solely from an elapsed isotretinoin washout.
No personalized genotype/race-based DHA dose or testing recommendation. Bayesian posterior probabilities are not individual benefit probabilities; credible intervals differ from confidence intervals.
Gemini conflates anxiety and depression effect sizes. Depression SMD -.52; anxiety -.25; maintain separate outcomes.
LactMed reports lack of breastfeeding hydroquinone studies, not proven harm; distinguish precaution/unknown from established contraindication. Retain pregnancy avoidance and existing retinoid holds.
Vitamin D 2024 review addresses uncertainty of supplementation for obstetric outcomes; 2026 dose comparison is distinct. Do not infer dietary requirement or deficiency treatment is unnecessary.
Pneumatic compression vs rest is not a stocking-prevention trial; existing S127 evaluates stockings. Distinguish symptom relief, structural prevention and VTE care.

additional_constraints.rule: Commercial formula claim evidence must not be used to infer nutritional equivalence to human milk or superiority without direct credible evidence; regulated age-appropriate formula remains a safe and necessary feeding option when needed. No homemade, diluted or unregulated substitutes.

No causal claim that disposable diapers delay independent continence or that cloth or assisted infant toileting prevents disorders without appropriate evidence; distinguish cue recognition, assisted dryness and independent toileting. No forced or punitive training.

record.runtime_enforcement: not implemented; Claude must implement and test before any release

record.rule: Hold all discrepant 2026 vitamin D regimen numerical displays and GDM claims until version/table adjudication.
Correct prior DR003 overbroad no effect modification: timing interaction reported; no modeled timing prescription.
No personalized genotype/race dosing; preserve GE-H04.
Preserve pregnancy probiotic PE signal; no routine prevention recommendation or extrapolation to fermented foods.
Anonymous nonrepresentative sample; no brand identification, fear claim or recommendation to stop prenatal vitamins.
Reference intakes not supplement doses; age, form-specific UL, clinical need and diet matter; no auto-dosing.
No direct comparison of effect magnitudes between linear and log concentration units; preserve date-specific author affiliations and no fraud inference.
No historical animal-study funding count as current human harm rate or percent biased.
Never change formula ratio, sanitation, hot-water precautions, storage or safe water source because of microplastics; glass optional, breakage hazard.
Do not alter vaccination or breastfeeding based on PFAS antibody/exposure studies; clinician evaluation.
Review search end-date differs in PubMed abstract and figure caption; hold coverage date until source verified.
Do not present 2026 PFAS proposed rules as final or legal limit as no-risk threshold.
Hold numerical charts with unverified exposure scale or comparison.
No causal offspring benefit, fertility guarantee, rigid paternal heat washout or epigenetic score from semen markers.
Known lead/nitrate/CO exposure: prioritize safe source and professional/emergency guidance; no home detox or delay.
Biomarker reductions are not demonstrated clinical benefits; do not rank products by unvalidated toxicity scores.
Severe vomiting/dehydration must trigger care; no ginger treatment delay.
No dates induction recipe or claim of avoiding cesarean; distinguish food from intervention, timing and glycemic needs.
No castor oil or herbal self-induction, or delay indicated obstetric care.
No DIY moxibustion heat/smoke technique, no replacement for obstetric breech assessment.
Do not advertise 47% increased supply from nonsignificant primary result.
No domperidone acquisition/dosing or abrupt stopping advice.
Malformed indexed interval; quarantine until original corrected result verified.
No home RF or elective pregnancy device recommendation; retain serious adverse event warning.
Postpartum RF dyspareunia trial research only; no vaginal rejuvenation endorsement; full disclosure and safety pending.
Confirm DSM strain discrepancy in original article and linked studies before import; no broad probiotic recommendation.
No preterm infant home probiotic use; specialist NICU safety and regulation.
No spinal manipulation/mobilization on infants or at-home manipulation directions.
Avoid placenta capsule ingestion; no encapsulation steps or infection reassurance.
No vaginal seeding outside approved clinical research; no DIY transfer.
Do not merge 2016 Cochrane web summary with 2026 update; verify version-specific results.
Kangaroo care under appropriate neonatal plan; no sleeping caregiver or unsafe infant sleep.
Avoid ashwagandha in pregnancy/lactation; no high-dose herbal mixtures.
No infant essential oil ingestion or concentrated application; suspected poisoning needs poison control/emergency guidance.
No honey under 12 months; no herbal liquids replacing appropriate milk.
No teething jewelry, homeopathic tablets, benzocaine or lidocaine recommendation.
No yoga/exercise replacement for clinical mental health care; urgent self-harm or postpartum psychosis escalation.

integrity_hold.rule: Retraction chain documented: DR021 Results explicitly includes refs 8,9,11, which are DR024,DR023,DR025 respectively. DR022 Table 1/ref34 includes DR021. Do not promote affected estimates until outcome-specific reanalysis; no claim of formal retraction of either synthesis. Search other reviews and guidelines for the same trial IDs.

rules: Most restrictive rule wins. All clinical data remain draft even if no explicit hold applies.
